long_tx_tpcc_lock_hold_w_shard.success_criteria: During or shortly after execution: lock_contention indicators increase and either p95 latency rises by >=50% or QPS drops by >=30%.
long_tx_tpcc_lock_hold_w_shard.risk_assessment: Holds row and next-key locks on hot TPC-C rows (district and stock) across up to 4 warehouses for ~12s. Expect lock waits, slow queries, possible deadlocks. Use only in non-production.
